question: Can the launch, gate, entry, observation and restore path reach a graded night on a second game, on the same handset?

run1_night1.method: Single tap on LOAD GAME, GATED on the validated title model (refuse unless rc=0 and `continue` present). Zero input thereafter. 34 frames at ~10 s.
run1_night1.outcome: 6 AM reached on Night 1 with zero input
evidence: Office held ~240 s, matching the dump-measured 40 s/hour x 6 for Night 1 specifically.
No jumpscare or game-over frame in 34 captures.
A post-night minigame played, which in FNaF 3 follows a completed night.
DECISIVE and independent of any frame reading: the title afterwards reads LOAD GAME 2. The game itself banked the night.
run1_night1.whyItNeededNoControlMap: Night 1 has no Springtrap, no phantoms and no system errors, so it is the cheapest possible proof of the end-to-end path while the control map is still blocked on schema (plans/26 blocker 1).

run2_actuation.method: Same gated entry on Night 2, then ONE tap at screen (880,1020), measured from run 1's own office frames.
run2_actuation.outcome: The maintenance panel opened and stayed open across three frames (office 1654170 B -> ~1000000 B sustained), verified visually.
run2_actuation.correction: That coordinate is the MAINTENANCE PANEL tab, not the monitor flip as predicted. The bottom-centre tab with a downward chevron and TAP raises maintenance. The monitor flip is a different control and remains unmeasured.
run2_actuation.crossCheck: The panel lists exactly four reboot options -- audio devices, camera system, ventilation, reboot all -- which independently confirms the dump extraction where `rebooting` is set to 1/2/3/4 by four separate click handlers each gated on `rebooting = 0`. Source and screen agree without anyone having arranged it.

findings: The title model gated two real actions and passed both. That is the first time it authorised rather than merely reported, which is what a gate is for.
The office HUD renders the night number and the in-game hour at the top right, so a future 6 AM can be READ rather than inferred from elapsed time. Every claim above would have been cheaper with it.

defect.severity: would have destroyed the evidence it was creating
defect.detail: The ad-hoc capture loop force-stopped FNaF 3 DURING the post-night minigame. FNaF 3 happens to bank the night before that sequence, so the evidence survived by luck. Had the game banked after it, the run would have erased its own result.
defect.fix: tools/device/game-teardown.sh -- a committed teardown that refuses to stop a game while a post-night sequence may still be running, and the FNAF_TEARDOWN_SETTLE_MS floor it carries.

notMeasured: The New Game dialog negative for the title model's menu_gate.
A control map expressed as world x + layer + view offset; device-profile-v1 cannot hold it.

frames.note: Game frames are never committed (docs/evidence/README.md publishing boundary). This record is the derived reading.

rung: None. plans/26 states that nothing in it is a claim or a Plan 12 rung. A zero-input Night 1 is not a route result.
